values.lede: trucks, trailers, parts and service, with our aftermarket facility minutes away.

values.heading: When each department is open.
values.note: Saturday service coverage varies. Call (813) 521-8053 to confirm before bringing a unit in on a Saturday.

features.title: Truck sales
features.body: New and used International trucks, IC Bus and Capacity yard trucks, plus the truck configurator and financing.

features.title: Parts counter
features.body: Genuine OEM and all-makes parts for trucks and trailers, with online ordering and delivery across the Tampa Bay area.

features.title: Service & trailer bays
features.body: Factory-trained technicians, dedicated trailer repair bays, DOT inspections, alignment, and mobile service dispatch.

features.title: In-store shopping
features.body: In-store shopping and curbside pickup, with after-hours service coverage through Certified Fleet.

panels.title: Trailer Sales — 6020 E Adamo Dr
panels.body: New and used Hyundai Translead and Globe Trailers share the Tampa address, open 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Monday through Friday. Talk to a member of our sales team about available inventory, financing, or to schedule an in-person appointment.

panels.title: Aftermarket Parts — 7105 E 6th Ave
panels.body: Minutes from the dealership, our Tampa aftermarket facility handles truck equipment repair, roll off cable repair, hydraulic repairs, body installations, liftgates and frame modifications, open 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM Monday through Friday.

values.heading: Other Sun State locations.
values.body: Ready to find the right commercial trucks for your business? Visit us at our convenient locations across Central and Southwest Florida.

values.heading: Ready to get on the road?
values.body: Contact us to explore our trucks and experience nothing less than the dedicated care you deserve.

items.q: Where is the Brooksville parts store?
items.a: Sun State Truck & Trailer Parts is at 17127 Runway Drive, Brooksville, FL 34604, near the Brooksville-Tampa Bay Regional Airport industrial park. Call (352) 277-0221.

items.q: What are the Brooksville store hours?
items.a: The store is open 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM Monday through Friday, and closed Saturday and Sunday.

items.q: Does Brooksville offer pickup and delivery?
items.a: Yes. Brooksville offers in-store shopping, in-store pickup and delivery of parts.

items.q: What kind of parts does Brooksville stock?
items.a: Genuine OEM and high-quality aftermarket parts for heavy and medium-duty trucks and trailers, including Hyundai and all-makes trailer parts. Anything not on the shelf is sourced through our supplier network and the other Sun State locations.

items.q: Is service work done at Brooksville?
items.a: Brooksville is a parts store. Truck and trailer service is performed at our Tampa, Davenport and Sarasota dealerships, and our mobile service team can come to your location.
